audit.citation_contract: All four permitted governed evidence identifiers and the independently recomputed claim inventory were present in each blinded packet row; no P, R, or T citation was rejected as absent.
audit.primary_result: Both isolated passes marked P, tool-enabled R, and T as identifying the route-change mechanism without material error. This is a genuine development tie, not missing evidence for an advantage.
audit.N_result: Both passes rejected N for unsupported signed odometry scope; pass 1 additionally rejected source/configuration claims not decoded in the no-computation packet.
audit.identical_text_repeatability: P used deterministic fallback and is byte-identical to T. Both passes agreed on their primary endpoint, but pass 2 labeled P partial and T full, so secondary disposition is not perfectly repeatable even for identical text/question/evidence/rubric.
audit.coverage_variation: The two passes varied on whether action duration and next-check specificity made an otherwise correct response full or partial. These secondary differences do not alter supported diagnostic success but must remain visible.

next_action: Do not collect more easy route-change variants. The fair R baseline already matches P on this scenario; a future candidate needs a validated multi-mechanism composition case or a separately developed methodological improvement before confirmation.
